title: Create src/tui/components/SpinnerPreview.tsx
description: Create the Ink component that shows a spinner alongside a rolling preview of the last 3-5 lines of AI output. Lines are truncated to terminal width and dimmed for readability.
acceptanceCriteria: SpinnerPreview component renders a spinner and output preview
Shows last 3-5 lines of AI output
Lines are truncated to terminal width
Preview text is displayed in a dimmed color
Updates as new output lines arrive

steps.details: Create the file. Import React, Box, Text from ink. Import Spinner from ink-spinner.

steps.description: Define props and compute preview lines
steps.details: export function SpinnerPreview({ lines }: { lines: string[] }). const maxWidth = (process.stdout.columns || 80) - 4. const previewLines = lines.slice(-5).map(l => l.length > maxWidth ? l.slice(0, maxWidth) + '…' : l)
Return: <Box><Spinner type='dots' /><Box flexDirection='column' marginLeft={1}>{previewLines.map((line, i) => <Text key={i} dimColor>{line}</Text>)}</Box></Box>

technicalNotes: ink-spinner provides multiple spinner types — 'dots' is the default animated dots pattern
dimColor is an Ink Text prop that renders the text at reduced brightness
